title: Level Info (Alpine)
doc: Per-level options read by Alpine Faction from <levelname>_info.tbl when that level loads (packfile or loose file).

alpine.notes: Alpine reads this file line by line, not with the game's table parser: lines are trimmed, everything before a line that is exactly #Start is ignored, reading stops at a line that is exactly #End, blank lines and lines starting with // are skipped, and every other line is 'name: value' split at the first colon. Field order does not matter, a later line overrides an earlier one, and unknown names are only logged. Comments after a value become part of the value. The file is looked up by the level file name with .rfl replaced by _info.tbl.

sections.name: #Start
sections.doc: Options between #Start and #End, in any order.

fields.name: $Lightmap Clamp Floor:
fields.doc: Lowest lightmap colour allowed on this level. Colour as hex RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA, or r, g, b (optionally in { } or < >), quotes optional.

fields.name: $Lightmap Clamp Ceiling:
fields.doc: Highest lightmap colour allowed on this level. Colour as hex RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA, or r, g, b (optionally in { } or < >), quotes optional.

fields.name: $Ideal Player Count:
fields.doc: Player count the level is designed for, shown to server browsers.

fields.name: $Author Contact:
fields.doc: How to reach the level author.

fields.name: $Author Website:
fields.doc: Level author's website.

fields.name: $Description:
fields.doc: Short description of the level.

fields.name: $Player Headlamp Color:
fields.doc: Head lamp colour on this level. Colour as hex RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA, or r, g, b (optionally in { } or < >), quotes optional.

fields.name: $Player Headlamp Intensity:
fields.doc: Head lamp intensity on this level.

fields.name: $Player Headlamp Range:
fields.doc: Head lamp range on this level.

fields.name: $Player Headlamp Radius:
fields.doc: Head lamp cone radius on this level.

fields.name: $Use Vertex Lighting:
fields.doc: Use the legacy vertex lighting for meshes on this level. 1, true or True mean yes; anything else means no.

fields.name: $Pixel Lighting Overbright:
fields.doc: Allowed overbright range of pixel lighting on this level.

fields.name: $Mesh Replacement:
fields.doc: Swap a mesh on this level: { "original", "replacement" } with both names quoted and a comma between; the replacement name is at most 31 characters.
